macd_optimization.methodology: Every enhancement was tested INDEPENDENTLY on MACD Cross only. Entry filters and exit parameters were selected on each window's TRAINING data and then applied unchanged to the unseen TEST window; risk rules are fixed (untuned) portfolio-level policies replayed over the test windows. Entry filters only remove baseline entries. Trade-level tables use a fixed ₹100,000 notional per trade; portfolio tables start each window at ₹5,000 and chain across windows. Rejected enhancements are preserved with reasons.

combined.validation_caveat: Each individual variation was accepted or rejected on unseen test windows (a fair out-of-sample test). The COMBINED configuration, however, is built from the variations that happened to pass on those same test windows, so its combined results carry selection bias and should be treated as exploratory — not as an independent out-of-sample validation. Confirmation requires fresh data the optimizer has never seen (continued paper trading).

alpha_generation.safety: ANALYSIS ONLY — Alpha Generation Engine. No strategy candidate in this report affects live or paper-trading decisions. A candidate must demonstrate positive net expectancy, PF ≥ 1.15, acceptable drawdown, sufficient sample size, multi-window consistency, and no excessive concentration before it can even be PROPOSED for a future iteration.

candidates.name: MACD × Volume Surge
candidates.description: Require strong volume confirmation at the signal bar (volume ratio ≥ 1.5× 20-day average). Eliminates low-conviction breakouts triggered on thin volume.
candidates.verdict_rationale: INCONCLUSIVE — 1 gate(s) failed: Max drawdown < 60.0%. Needs more data or parameter refinement.

candidates.name: MACD × Strong Trend (ADX ≥ 25)
candidates.description: Multi-timeframe trend confirmation: only enter when ADX confirms a defined trend (≥ 25). Avoids whipsaw MACD signals in ranging, trendless markets.
candidates.verdict_rationale: REJECT — negative expectancy after costs (-0.899%/trade). Filter reduces edge rather than adding it.

candidates.name: MACD × Low Volatility (ATR% < 1.5%)
candidates.description: Restrict entries to calm, low-volatility environments (daily ATR < 1.5% of price). Low-ATR periods tend to produce cleaner MACD crossovers with less noise.
candidates.verdict_rationale: REJECT — insufficient sample size: only 5 trades (minimum 10 required).

candidates.name: MACD × Bearish Regime
candidates.description: Per Phase 4 robustness findings: MACD Cross shows its best out-of-sample expectancy specifically in Bearish market regimes, likely from mean-reversion dynamics.
candidates.verdict_rationale: REJECT — negative expectancy after costs (-0.584%/trade). Filter reduces edge rather than adding it.

candidates.name: MACD × VWAP Confirmation
candidates.description: Only trade when price is above VWAP at the signal bar. VWAP acts as an intraday fair-value anchor; above-VWAP entries confirm institutional buying pressure.
candidates.verdict_rationale: REJECT — negative expectancy after costs (-0.287%/trade). Filter reduces edge rather than adding it.

candidates.name: MACD × Relative Strength vs NIFTY
candidates.description: Multi-timeframe momentum filter: only enter stocks that outperformed NIFTY 50 over the 60 trading days before entry. Focuses capital on market leaders, not laggards.
candidates.verdict_rationale: REJECT — negative expectancy after costs (-0.530%/trade). Filter reduces edge rather than adding it.

candidates.name: MACD × Sector Focus (Consumer + Infra)
candidates.description: Concentrate on the two highest-expectancy sectors from Phase 4 analysis: CONSUMER and INFRA. Systematically removes negative-expectancy sectors (IT, TELECOM, FMCG).
candidates.verdict_rationale: INCONCLUSIVE — 1 gate(s) failed: Top-5 trades ≤ 70% of gross profit. Needs more data or parameter refinement.

candidates.name: MACD × Short Duration (≤ 5 days)
candidates.description: Capture quick MACD momentum moves and exit within 5 trading days. Reduces overnight and weekend risk; improves capital turnover and limits time-in-market.
candidates.verdict_rationale: REJECT — negative expectancy after costs (-2.475%/trade). Filter reduces edge rather than adding it.

candidates.name: MACD × Volume + Trend (V + T)
candidates.description: Two orthogonal confirmations from independent domains: volume surge (≥ 1.5×) confirms participation, AND strong ADX (≥ 25) confirms a defined trend. Rejects both low-volume breakouts and weak-trend crossovers.
candidates.verdict_rationale: INCONCLUSIVE — 2 gate(s) failed: ≥ 30 OOS trades; Top-5 trades ≤ 70% of gross profit. Needs more data or parameter refinement.

candidates.name: MACD × Multi-Signal (V + T + VWAP)
candidates.description: High-conviction triple intersection: volume surge (≥ 1.5×) AND strong trend (ADX ≥ 25) AND price above VWAP. Three independent confirming signals; fewer trades, significantly higher signal quality threshold.
candidates.verdict_rationale: REJECT — insufficient sample size: only 5 trades (minimum 10 required).
